title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Mercedes G63 6x6
description:
A Mercedes G 63 AMG 6x6 weighs about nine thousand pounds, stands on thirty-seven inch tyres, and was priced at three hundred seventy-nine thousand euros when new. Roughly one hundred were built. In this video we explain two things you probably did not know about it: what it really is underneath, and where its hardware went afterwards. Every figure comes from a named source. We used Wikipedia's pages on the 6x6 and on the G-Class, Gear Patrol, The Drive, Road and Track via Motor Authority, CarAdvice via Driven Car Guide, MercedesBlog and Carscoops. They disagree in places, for example on power, price and dates. We show the disagreements. Our own maths is labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
